name: Critical Arrow Storm
body:
When you nock an arrow in your bow a tingling sensation comes over your fingers. You release the arrow as it soars through the air with magical energy, seeking out your target’s weakest and most vital areas.

Prerequisite(s): Dex 19, 7th-level arcane archer

Benefit: When you use your hail of arrows ability, every arrow that strikes a target is automatically a confirmed critical hit.
